notes: Rack units omitted — this is a desktop/ceiling-mount PTZ camera, not rack-mountable. Physical I/O and labels taken from Marshall's official CV730-NDI User Manual (rear panel diagram, section 3.1.2, page 8), cross-checked with the official Marshall cutsheet/datasheet (CV730-NDIW). Power connector on manual/cutsheet is specified as "EIAJ-04" DC barrel type, 12V DC — mapped to the closest available enum value dc-barrel. RS-422 physically ships as a pluggable screw-terminal block (per package contents, "RS-422 Connector") — mapped to euroblock with accepts:[rs422] since rs422 is a signal standard, not itself a connector shape in this list. USB 3.0 port is present on the chassis but manual states it is a reserved/non-functional hole pending future firmware; type is Type-B per corroborating third-party sources (not 100% explicit in the primary manual, hence medium-confidence sub-detail) — grade usb-5g reflects USB 3.0/3.1 Gen1 nominal spec. Ethernet (RJ45) port grade/speed (e.g., 1G) is not explicitly stated in the manual or cutsheet, so grade was omitted rather than assumed. Model is also sold as CV730-NDIW (white color variant) and CV730-BHN/WHN (rebrand); I/O is identical across color variants. A newer CV730-ND3/ND3W sibling (NDI|HX3) supersedes this model with similar but not identical I/O — do not conflate.

ports.name: RS-422 Port
ports.note: 8-pin pluggable terminal block (included accessory) carrying RS-422; daisy-chain up to 7 cameras

ports.name: Audio Input
ports.note: 3.5mm TRS stereo, switchable Line In/Mic In

ports.name: Network Port
ports.note: Ethernet for NDI|HX2/IP control; supports PoE++ (IEEE 802.3bt) power input

ports.name: USB 3.0 Port
ports.note: Physically present but reserved/non-functional in current firmware per manual

ports.name: DC 12V Power Connector
ports.note: EIAJ-04 DC barrel connector, 12V (10.8-13.0V DC), used with included AC power adapter/cord; camera can alternatively be powered via PoE++ on the network port
